jobs.title: Physics Research Experiences for Undergraduates (REU) - University of Washington
jobs.description:
Welcome, Physics REU applicant!
   This is the application for the Summer 2026 Physics Research
   Experiences for Undergraduates program at the University of Washington
   in Seattle, WA.
   Program Dates: June 22 - August 28, 2026
   Participants must be U.S. citizens or permanent residents to be
   supported by our NSF funding. If accepted, you will be required to
   show proof of citizenship or permanent residency.
   This program is not intended for University of Washington students. If
   you are a current University of Washington student who is interested
   in research opportunities at the University of Washington, please
   email uwreu@phys.washington.edu for more information.

   The main goal of this program is to provide an exciting and nurturing
   physics research experience for students, one that will encourage them
   to pursue careers as research scientists. Each student is paired with
   a faculty adviser and is often supported by interested postdocs and
   advanced graduate students. Students participate in a 10-week research
   program, including in most cases a machine shop course. Students meet
   weekly to discuss their research progress with the program directors
   and to attend a lecture series on research opportunities in physics.
   At the end of the 10-week program students present short talks on
   their research accomplishments and write summary reports on their
   projects.
   The program will provide a 10-week stipend of $7000, campus housing &
   meal service, and a travel supplement up to $500. In the event the UW
   REU program cannot be held in-person, it will be held virtually.
   APPLICATION INSTRUCTIONS:
   Before you begin the application process, please review the University
   of Washington Privacy Notice and have the following items and
   information ready as you will be asked to attach the file or enter the
   information before you can complete your application.

     * A cover letter explaining your interest in our program (file to be
       attached).

     * An unofficial transcript (file to be attached). If you attended
       more than one college, it is advisable to have a transcript from
       each. NOTE: If you are selected to participate in our program, at
       that time you will be required to provide an official transcript
       mailed by your college registrar.

     * Your GPA for science/math/computer science courses.

     * Your GPA for all courses.

     * The names and email addresses of two professors who can provide
       letters of recommendation (you may provide more than two if you
       wish). Follow the instructions on the application page to send an
       email request to your reference writers for a letter of
       recommendation. Please let your references know in advance that
       the email will come from "AcademicJobsOnline.org", so that they do
       not think it is spam.

   When you have those items ready, click on the "Apply" link above.

     * You will first need to complete the "Standard Coversheet" where
       you will enter your contact information and the names and email
       addresses of your references. Please fill in all fields that have
       a red asterisk and provide information for at least two
       references. If fields without an asterisk seem confusing or
       irrelevant, please just leave them blank.

     * After you have submitted your "Standard Coversheet", you will be
       directed to our specific application page to answer additional
       questions, activate your reference letter requests, and upload
       your cover letter and transcript. When you have successfully
       submitted the application page, you should receive an email from
       the system.

     * After you complete the application, please consider filling out
       the optional demographic survey. The survey link will be provided
       to you via email after you submit your application.

       * The information requested in the demographic survey will be used
         to evaluate our program's outreach efforts. All responses will
         remain anonymous. Participation in the demographic survey is not
         required to complete your REU application.

   The application deadline (including references) is February 22, 2026,
   11:59PM Eastern Standard Time. Early application is recommended.
   We will begin making offers in early March, and hope to complete the
   process by the 3rd week of March.
   For additional detailed information about this Physics REU program,
   please see our website: https://sites.google.com/uw.edu/uwreu
   Note: This year our REU program is pending renewal funding from the
   NSF. We hope to have clarity on this matter before the application
   deadline. This posting will be updated when new information is
   available.
   General inquiries may be sent to: uwreu@phys.washington.edu

jobs.title: 2025-3 Recruitment Announcement for Senior Researcher Positions at the IBS CTPU-PTC (Particle Theory and Cosmology)
jobs.description:
CTPU-PTC Senior Researcher Positions
   ------------------------------------


   Theoretical high-energy physics, cosmology, PIML & QS for HEP
   -------------------------------------------------------------


   Announcement

   The Particle Theory and Cosmology Group (PTC) of the Center for
   Theoretical Physics of the Universe (CTPU) at the Institute for Basic
   Science (IBS), South Korea, invites applications for several senior
   researcher positions in theoretical high-energy physics and cosmology.
   The research areas of interest include (but not limited to) the
   following fields(*1,*2):

   1) Physics beyond the Standard Model and Cosmology

   axion physics, dark matter, flavor and CP violation, astroparticle
   physics, cosmological phase transition, ultra-light boson cosmology,
   topological defects, multi-messenger astrophysics, neutrino physics,
   collider physics, precision tests, etc.

   2) PIML & QS for HEP (Physics-informed Machine Learning and Quantum
   Simulation for HEP)

   simulation-based inference for collider and astrophysics (e.g., jet
   physics, galactic dynamics, and dark matter), physics-informed
   generative modeling and representation learning, domain adaptation,
   ML-assisted lattice field theory, and quantum algorithms and
   Hamiltonian simulation for high-energy physics, etc.

   The CTPU-PTC group, whose activities have been led by Kiwoon Choi
   since their inception in 2013, consists of five faculty members, one
   IBS Young Scientist Fellow, and 14 senior research fellows, together
   with several affiliated faculty members who work closely with the
   group. We also maintain active collaboration with the Cosmology,
   Gravity and Astroparticle Physics Group (CTPU-CGA), led by Masahide
   Yamaguchi, and strong ties with IBS experimental centers such as the
   Dark Matter Axion Group (DMAG), the Center for Underground Physics
   (CUP), and the Center for Exotic Nuclear Studies (CENS). In addition,
   the CTPU-PTC group is developing a dedicated research program in PIML
   & QS for HEP, carried out by a multidisciplinary team working across
   these areas.

   Overall, the PTC group sustains a broad research program across the
   topics listed above, engages in collaborations with researchers
   worldwide, and runs an active schedule of conferences, workshops,
   focused programs, and regular seminars. These activities are
   documented on our Indico page.

   The positions can start any time before December 16, 2026, provided
   that all appointment requirements are fulfilled by the starting
   date.(*3) The initial appointment will be for two years, with the
   possibility of a one-year extension subject to performance review and
   the funding situation.(*4)

   Applications should include curriculum vitae, publication list,
   research statement, and at least three letters of recommendation.
   Applicants will also be asked, in the Academic Jobs Online form, to
   indicate their primary research areas including the themes listed
   above. In addition, applicants are required to complete and upload the
   IBS personal information consent and application form ("Consent to
   Collection and Use of Personal Information and Application for IBS"),
   which can be downloaded from the official IBS announcement (IBS Job
   Board). For full consideration, all application materials, including
   reference letters, should be submitted through Academic Jobs Online by
   January 05, 2026, 23:59 (KST).

   (*1) Although the official IBS title of the position is “Senior
   Researcher”, this recruitment is effectively aimed at postdoctoral
   level researchers, including fresh PhD graduates.

   (*2) The official language of the center is English.

   (*3) The doctoral degree must be obtained by the appointment start
   date.

   (*4) The standard additional term is one year; in exceptional cases of
   outstanding performance, the total additional term may be up to three
   years.

   ---------------------------------------------------------------------


   Job Overview

     *  Affiliation (workplace): CTPU-PTC (IBS HQ, Daejeon, Korea)

     *  Job Category: Senior Researcher

     *  Recruitment Area: Theoretical high-energy physics, cosmology,
       PIML & QS for HEP

     *  Required Qualifications:

         1.  Degree: Doctoral degree (must be obtained by December 16,
           2026, and a certificate must be submitted before the actual
           appointment date.)

         2.  Major: Physics

     *  No. of Openings: 6

   ---------------------------------------------------------------------


   Application Submission and Deadline

   How to apply: Submit the documents through AcademicJobsOnline

     *  CV

     *  Publication List

     *  Research Statement

     *  At least three Letters of Recommendation

     *  Answers to the questions on the Research Areas of Interest (in
       AJO Additional Questions Form)

     *  The required IBS consent & application form - "Consent to
       Collection and Use of Personal Information and Application for
       IBS" (downloadable from the IBS Job Board)

   Deadline for application submission: January 05, 2026 (23:59) KST

     *  Inquiries: Recruiting Manager of CTPU-PTC (E-mail:
       ctpu_recruit@ibs.re.kr）

   ---------------------------------------------------------------------

   ---------------------------------------------------------------------

   ---------------------------------------------------------------------

   ---------------------------------------------------------------------

   ---------------------------------------------------------------------


   Miscellaneous
   -------------


   Qualifications

   General qualifications

     *  Must be in compliance with the requirements for appointments as
       specified in Article 33 of the State Public Officials Act and IBS
       statutes.

     *  If candidates are found to be former public officials dismissed
       for corruption as set forth in Article 82 of the Act on the
       Prevention of Corruption and the Establishment of the
       Anti-corruption and Civil Rights Commission, the job offer will be
       withdrawn.

     *  Those who completed mandatory military service or exempt from
       such service, and permitted to travel abroad

   ※ The military service exemption positions (전문연구요원) are not eligible
   for this announcement

   Preferences

     *  Individuals with disabilities as defined in Articles 3 and 4 of
       the Enforcement Decree of the Act on the Employment Promotion and
       Vocational Rehabilitation of Persons with Disabilities, or
       individuals eligible for employment assistance as defined in
       Article 29 of the Act on the Honorable Treatment of and Support
       for Persons, Etc. of Distinguished Service to the State
       (additional points will be given during the screening/evaluation
       process)

     *  5 additional points for those who submit the certificate of
       disabilities

     *  5-10 additional points for those who submit the certificate of
       employment protection for the national war veteran

     *  Women in science, engineering and technology as defined in
       Article 2 of the Act on Fostering and Supporting Women Scientists
       and Technicians

   ※ Apply the highest additional points across all preferences.

   ---------------------------------------------------------------------


   Screening Process

   Step 1 (Document Screening): January 12 ~ January 15, 2026
   Suitability for the position and for the field of work, excellence of
   the applicant’s research achievements, overall research activities,
   Excellence of research plan, etc. Approximately 7 times the number of
   applicants than the number of vacancies will be selected for the
   interview in order of the highest scores with the minimum average
   score of 80. CV, publication list, research statement, answers to the
   questions on the research area of interest (as the additional
   questions in the AJO application form), Consent form & Application for
   IBS (from IBS job Board), at least three letters of recommendation.

   Step 2(Interview Screening): January 19 ~ January 30, 2026
   Expertise in their field, attitude and communication skills,
   presentation skills, excellence of their research, development
   potential, and prospect, etc. Final candidates will be selected in
   order of the highest scores, with a minimum average score of 80.

   ※ The procedure allows for a successful candidate and up to two
   additional waiting list candidates per opening in accordance with the
   scores.
   ※ There can be additional required documents according to the
   situation at the center:
   ※ The schedule may change according to the situation at IBS

     *  A preliminary successful candidate may be determined within the
       range of two times the number of persons to be hired, and the
       effect of the preliminary successful candidate shall be limited to
       three months from the earliest of the scheduled appointment date
       or the final successful candidate's appointment date.

     *  During the validity period of the preliminary successful
       candidate, ① if the reason for the renunciation of employment or
       disqualification of the final successful candidate occurs, and ②
       if recruitment is necessary due to the withdrawal of the appointed
       employee, the appointment may be made according to the preliminary
       acceptance order.

   ---------------------------------------------------------------------


   Terms & Conditions

     *  The revised guidelines of the Ministry of Employment and Labor,
       and the Ministry of Economy and Finance (revision on 3 Nov. 2022,
       implementation on 1 Jan. 2024) have allowed a flexible application
       of the blind hiring policy to secure excellent researchers,
       thereby broadening the scope of information to be collected (e.g.,
       academic background, schools, period spent on obtaining degrees,
       reference letters [including referees’ information] and
       experience). However, personal information that can identify the
       applicant (e.g., gender and age) is still not collected.

     *  CTPU-PTC, IBS is an Equal Opportunity or Affirmative Action
       Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for
       employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual
       orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, age, or
       protected veteran status. Any biased information will not be
       provided to committees at all.

     *  Applicants will be responsible for any consequences of making
       mistakes, missing information or not submitting required
       documentation in their applications. If any information is found
       to be incorrect or false, the job offer will be withdrawn.

     *  Submitted documents may be returned when a request is made within
       three months from the announcement of the final result in
       accordance with Article 4 of the Enforcement Decree of the Fair
       Hiring Procedure Act.

     *  If candidates are disqualified due to a background check or a
       physical examination result, the job offer will be withdrawn.

     *  If candidates are found to be former public officials dismissed
       for corruption as set forth in Article 82 of the Act on the
       Prevention of Corruption and the Establishment of the
       Anti-corruption and Civil Rights Commission, the job offer will be
       withdrawn.

     *  No applicants may be hired if there are no applicants deemed
       qualified during the screening process.

     *  If hired, the job category/grade and annual salary will be
       determined in accordance with IBS rules and regulations.

     *  Workplace: CTPU-PTC, IBS HQ, Daejeon

     *  Inquiries: Recruiting Manager of CTPU-PTC (E-mail:
       ctpu_recruit@ibs.re.kr）

jobs.title: Postdoctoral Fellow
jobs.institution: Hong Kong University of Science and Technology
jobs.description:
The IAS Center for Fundamental Physics (IAS CFP) (http://cfp.ust.hk) of
   The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology (HKUST) invites
   applications for postdoctoral positions in the areas of theoretical
   particle physics, particle astrophysics and gravitational wave
   astronomy (LIGO-Virgo-KAGRA and Pulsar-Timing-Array programs
   preferred), and cosmology (duration: 2 years, renewable upon good
   performance and mutual agreement). The faculty members of the IAS CFP
   are affiliated with the Department of Physics and/or the Jockey Club
   Institute for Advanced Study (IAS) at HKUST, including Andrew Cohen,
   Tao Liu, Kam-Biu Luk, Kirill Prokofiev, Henry Tye (Emeritus), Yi Wang
   and Yue Zhao. The salary of the position is highly competitive and
   will be commensurate with the appointee’s qualifications and
   experience. Fringe benefits including annual leave, medical and dental
   benefits will be provided. For truly exceptional cases, appointment as
   non-tenure-track research assistant professor may be possible.
   Application including curriculum vitae, list of publications, research
   statement, and at least three letters of reference must be submitted
   via Academic Jobs Online. Review of applications will begin on 15
   December 2025, and will continue until the positions are filled.

jobs.title: Postdoc Positions in Particle Physics
jobs.description:
The Center for Particle Physics, Astrophysics, and Cosmology (NNU-PP) at
   Nanjing Normal University invites applications for 1-2 postdoctoral
   research positions. We seek outstanding candidates to join our group
   in one or more of the following areas, including but not limited to:

     * Higgs Physics

     * Cosmological Phase Transition

     * Gravitational Wave

     * Baryogenesis

     * AI4Science

   About NNU-PP
   Our research center hosts an active and dynamic group of researchers,
   including faculty members Ariel Arza, Peter Athron, Ning Liu,
   Chih-Ting Lu, Lei Wu, and Yongcheng Wu. We offer a collaborative
   environment with ample opportunities for academic growth and
   interdisciplinary research.
   Position Details

     * Appointment: Initial term of 2 years, with a possibility of
       renewal for a third year based on performance.

     * Salary and Benefits:

       * Competitive salary commensurate with qualifications and
         experience.

       * Subsidized housing options through the university.

       * Exceptional candidates will be nominated for the prestigious
         China/Jiangsu Province Postdoctoral Innovative Talent Support
         Program. Successful nominees will receive enhanced benefits,
         including a significantly increased stipend and a dedicated
         travel budget, with the total annual salary package reaching up
         to 600,000 RMB/year.

   Application Requirements
   Interested candidates should prepare the following documents:

     1. Curriculum Vitae (CV)

     2. Publication List

     3. Research Statement (outlining past work and future plans)

   Applicants should also arrange for three reference letters to be
   submitted directly through Academic Jobs Online (AJO).
   Application Deadline
   All applications should be submitted no later than 2026/01/31. We look
   forward to receiving your application and welcoming you to our dynamic
   team at NNU-PP. For further information about the center and the
   position, please contact us via ycwu@njnu.edu.cn

jobs.title: Postdoc position in theoretical particle physics
jobs.description:
A 2+1 year postdoctoral position is open in the field of theoretical particle physics. The research project aims
at providing high-precision theoretical predictions for Today's and Tomorrow's particle accelerators.
To do so the framework of quantum field theory would be used, in particular perturbative Quantum Chromodynamics.

The position will take place at the Eotvos University (ELTE) in Budapest, Hungary.

Our research group seeks its new postdoc with strong foundation in theoretical particle physics. The
postdoc should also be fluent in English. PhD in perturbative QCD or electroweak corrections takes precedence.

The selected postdoc would receive the following benefits:
- Participating in state-of-art calculations important for the field
- Being part of a young, motivated and energetic research group and also part of a large, impactful international
  collaboration
- The position is research only (no teaching nor administrative duties)
- Competitive salary

The starting date is flexible it can be as early as March, 2026.

jobs.title: Assistant Professor
jobs.description:
The Particle Physics, Nuclear Physics, and Astrophysics Group in the Department of Physics at Tsinghua University invites applications for tenure-track faculty positions in particle physics, nuclear physics, and cosmology.

Faculty members in the Department of Physics at Tsinghua University are expected to conduct independent, forefront research and supervise both Ph.D. and undergraduate students. The positions are open to researchers of all nationalities and offer an internationally competitive salary, housing subsidy, and start-up funds. The expected start date is September 2026, with flexibility.

Applications should be submitted via AcademicJobsOnline (AJO). For full consideration, all application materials should be received by December 31, 2025. The search will remain open until the positions are filled.

jobs.title: Postdoc in theoretical high-energy physics and astroparticle physics
jobs.description:
The High Energy Theory group at the University of Utah invites
   applications for one or more postdoctoral positions to begin in
   approximately August 2026. Areas of specialization include theoretical
   and phenomenological high energy physics and astroparticle physics.
   Successful applicants will have research interests that overlap with
   those of Professors Gustavo Marques-Tavares, Pearl Sandick, and/or
   Zhengkang Zhang. Additional faculty in the High Energy Theory group
   include Professor Paolo Gondolo and Emeritus Professors Carleton DeTar
   and Yong-Shi Wu. You can learn more about research in the High Energy
   Theory group as well as other related research in the Department of
   Physics and Astronomy at https://www.physics.utah.edu/research/.
   Postdoctoral appointment(s) are annual and renewable for up to three
   years contingent on satisfactory performance and the availability of
   continued funding. Your complete application must include a CV,
   publication list, statement of research interests, and 3-5 reference
   letters. Complete applications received by December 15, 2025 will
   receive first consideration. Applications submitted after December 15
   will be considered only as long as a position is available.
   ******************************

jobs.title: Tufts University, Tufts Institute of Cosmology, Postdoctoral Scholar
jobs.description:
The Tufts Institute of Cosmology at Tufts University invites applications
   for one postdoctoral researcher position starting in September 2026.
   The position is a full-time, 24-month (two-year) appointment, which
   may be extended to a third year upon successful performance,
   availability of funding, and mutual agreement. The research is
   expected to be at the interface of theoretical cosmology and particle
   physics, including but not limited to early universe cosmology,
   aspects of dark matter, including axions and other models,
   gravitational waves, and applications of effective field theory. The
   faculty members in the cosmology group are Mark Hertzberg, Soubhik
   Kumar, and Ken Olum. The group also includes other postdocs, long-term
   visitors, and graduate students, and has a joint seminar series with
   MIT. The group also maintains strong connections with other cosmology
   and particle theory research groups in the greater Boston area, and
   such collaborations will be highly encouraged. More information about
   the group is available at
   https://as.tufts.edu/physics/tufts-institute-cosmology. Applicants are
   invited to send a cover letter, CV, a publication list, a statement of
   research interests (three pages maximum plus references), and arrange
   for three letters of reference to be sent via AJO. Applications
   received by December 15, 2025, will be given full consideration. For
   questions about this position, please contact Soubhik Kumar
   (soubhik.kumar (at) tufts.edu). Equal Employment Opportunity Statement
   Tufts University is an Equal Opportunity Employer. See the
   University’s Non-Discrimination statement and policy here
   https://oeo.tufts.edu/policies-procedures/non-discrimination/. If you
   are an applicant with a disability who is unable to use our online
   tools to search and apply for jobs, please contact us by calling the
   Office of Equal Opportunity (OEO) at 617-627-3298 or at oeo@tufts.edu.
   Applicants can learn more about requesting reasonable accommodations
   at https://oeo.tufts.edu/. Members of underrepresented groups are
   strongly encouraged to apply.
